title: The ball's total distance
caption: The ball falls 10 m, then rises and falls 6, 3.6, 2.16, … each twice. The bounces add to 2 × 6/(1 − 0.6) = 30 m, so the total distance is 10 + 30 = 40 m.
alt: One bar of 40 m split into a part of 10 m for the first drop and a part of 30 m for all the bounces.
description: Each rebound is 60% of the previous height: 6, 3.6, 2.16, …, travelled up and down.
